summary: Iteration 2 frontend retest after Zustand v5 individual-selector fix. Full free-tier funnel now works end-to-end (Landing → Identity → Confession → Processing → Severity → Protocol → Certificate → Schedule Delivery → Verification page). The critical iteration_1 bug (Submit Incident Report button doing nothing) is FIXED. Paid tier checkout endpoint confirmed callable (returns 200, redirects to Stripe). 100% of in-scope frontend flows pass.

issues: Brutalist design intent met: black/off-white palette, monospace, Chivo headlines, transparent borders, ministry seal, color-coded severity stamps (GREEN/GREY/AMBER/RED). Contrast and spacing acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: ConfessionStep.handleSubmit does not await any async backend call before transitioning to 'processing' — this is correct since the /api/analyze call is made inside ProcessingRitual's useEffect, but React StrictMode in dev causes the useEffect (and thus POST /api/analyze) to fire twice. Observed in network capture (2x POST /api/analyze, 2x GET /api/verify). Harmless in dev, but worth guarding with a ref or AbortController for production polish.

SeverityResult.handleContinue lacks user-facing error state — if POST /api/certificate fails, only console.error is called and the user is stuck on Severity. Recommend adding a visible error toast/inline message and a retry button.

ProtocolSelection.handleSelect for paid tiers does window.location.href = response.data.url without verifying response shape; if backend returns no url the user is silently stuck with loading=true forever. Add defensive check + error UI.
CertificateView.handleShare uses alert() for clipboard fallback — not ideal UX. Replace with toast.
ritualStore has no persistence layer (refresh during funnel resets state to 'landing'). Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
App.js pollPaymentStatus uses alert() and naive setTimeout polling — fine for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full free-tier funnel + verification + checkout API call all pass)

test_credentials: No auth required. Stripe checkout API was triggered but Stripe redirect was intentionally blocked in test (verified POST /api/checkout/session returned 200).
seed_data_creation: Created live free-tier certificate KR-2026-PA6662 (TEST_TestUser) via UI funnel; verified via GET /api/verify/KR-2026-PA6662.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend funnel is fully working. If new tests are added, exercise: (1) paid tier end-to-end with Stripe test card (would need to actually complete checkout — currently blocked by test routing rule), (2) anonymous identity path (verified working — 'Anonymous Entity' shown on cert), (3) StrictMode double-fire of /api/analyze should be addressed but is non-blocking. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_karma_api.py still pass — rerun via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` if backend changes.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iteration_1 bug was Zustand v5 incompatibility: components were destructuring the whole store object instead of using individual selectors, so React did not re-render on state changes. Main agent fixed by replacing `const {setStep, ...} = useRitualStore()` with `const setStep = useRitualStore(state => state.setStep)` across all funnel components. Verified by reproducing the full happy path: clicking Submit Incident Report now transitions to ProcessingRitual, which calls /api/analyze, then advances to SeverityResult → ProtocolSelection → CertificateView with QR code, with the Registry ID matching the required KR-YYYY-XX#### format (observed KR-2026-PA6662).
